prompt: Replace this table with the second result
assertions: search_products returns the deterministic catalog order
replace_object applies the second result to the selected table
Scene revision increments exactly once

prompt: Move the lamp using the stale revision
assertions: move_object returns SCENE_REVISION_CONFLICT with the latest revision
The Scene is not mutated

prompt: Add the product-backed scene objects to the cart
assertions: A visible approval dialog is opened
No external requests are made

prompt: Add the product-backed scene objects to the cart, then create the Shopify cart through the store's MCP server
assertions: In shopify mode the draft carries commerce.lines with merchandiseId and quantity plus commerce.mcpEndpoint
Draft items carry demoVariantId (the demo catalog id); only commerce.lines[].merchandiseId is sent to update_cart
Unmapped products appear in commerce.skipped and are not sent anywhere
OpenRoom makes no external request; the agent calls update_cart and get_cart on the store MCP itself

prompt: Turn the chair to face the sofa
assertions: move_object is called with facing pointing from the chair centre toward the sofa centre
The returned scene's chair facing matches the requested direction within 0.01
rotationYDegrees is not sent together with facing
search_products is called with category "side_table" and no price filter, because the contract has none
Results arrive in catalog order, capped by the unchanged limit of three
Only the returned side tables priced under $300 are offered to the shopper

prompt: Put the lamp on the side table
assertions: move_object is called with the lamp's objectId and the table's XZ centre
The returned lamp carries supportedBy set to that table's id
The returned lamp's position[1] is the table height plus half the lamp height, above its floor resting height
The seed scene has no side table, so the coffee table table_01 is the supporter the assertions name
move_object is called with the rug's own XZ centre, so the command is a turn in place
The 2.4 x 1.7 m rug spans 2.9 m across at 45 degrees and the room is 2.72 m deep, so no floor spot holds it
The rug keeps the rotation and the position it had, adjustedToFit is true, and the message reads "Rug kept at 0°: it does not fit the room at 45°."
A turn the room can hold keeps its floor spot, and slides by exactly the corner overshoot when one leaves the floor
